integrity: All-dimensional bounds analytically proved, exact finite dimension one through three enumeration reproduced, higher numerical witnesses corroborative only. No independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Exponential-order bound only: no optimal asymptotic coefficient; only real, unweighted Boolean-cube edge total variation and fixed common positive Walsh coefficient threshold. Possible unindexed historical equivalent.
title: Walsh spectral soft thresholding has sharp Boolean-cube variation amplification of order \(2^{d/2}\)
